All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket titled `fwrd52-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, initially status Draft, 0 parts, created 2026-09-15). Only the Title field was required in the New ticket dialog.

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd52-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts total $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd52-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total $375.00).

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**5. DONE** — Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with the app's validation alert — *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd52-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd52-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. Exactly what was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier** (the Supplier field is labelled "Optional" in the part dialog, but is enforced on the Ready transition). I set Supplier = "Bench Supplier Co" on both parts via each row's Edit button, after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status block read "Status / Ready".

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via row Delete → in-page Confirm dialog → "Delete part"; detail page then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." and the list Parts column showed 0). Ticket then archived via the detail page's "Archive ticket" button — no precondition blocked it, no error or confirmation prompt. Verified end state: the default active list dropped from 14 to 13 tickets ("Showing 1–10 of 13") and searching RD-1015 there returns "No tickets match the current filters."; with "Show archived" enabled the row reads "RD-1015 | fwrd52-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-15"; the detail page shows "Status / Ready / Archived", "No parts on this ticket yet.", and the action button is now "Unarchive ticket". Nothing created by this run remains active.
